name: messaging-send-android-light-settings
description: firebase-admin/messaging LightSettings: FCM accepts #RRGGBB and #RRGGBBAA LED colors with millisecond on/off durations, while negative durations or malformed hex colors fail client preflight with messaging/invalid-payload.

negativeLightOnDuration.message: android.notification.lightSettings.lightOnDurationMillis must be a non-negative duration in milliseconds
negativeLightOnDuration.name: Error

malformedColorShortHex.message: android.notification.lightSettings.color must be in the form #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA format
malformedColorShortHex.name: Error
